$description: BBDF canonical palette. Source: BBDF_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (canonical copy lives at BB_DOCS/__ROBOT__WORK__/BBDF_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, NOT in this directory -- this folder holds the assets, that file holds the rules) §1. Locked per workshop ratification 2026-05-14. Single palette, system-wide. Adding a token requires Mandy + Elaine sign-off + register update.

primary.$description: Header text, titles, section headings, body emphasis, table header row fills, INDEXED section numbering, logo name-stack text. Default body-text color.

accent.$description: Section dividers (header rule), AMOUNT DUE highlights, totals lines, important callouts. SEMANTIC ONLY — never decorative. Body text is always navy-primary.

text.$description: Footer band text — generated-date, page number, brand line.

positive.$description: Positive financial deltas, success states, paid-in-full indicators.

negative.$description: Negative financial deltas, error states, overdue AR.

muted.$description: Secondary text, contact lines, captions, INDEXED cross-reference labels (§2.3 (p. 7)).

rule.$description: Light rule above totals, alternating row dividers, TOC dot leaders.

alt-row.$description: Alternating table row backgrounds — subtle, near-white.

white.$description: Header band background, content background, table header text on navy fill.

text-black.$description: Logo name-stack DESIGN & FABRICATION tagline only (per spec §2.1 + §3.5). Contrast hierarchy against navy BEN BALL above. NOT used for body text — body stays navy-primary. Added v1.4 (Ben-pinned 2026-05-14); formally ratified v1.5 (Round 2 Flag 3 resolution).
